scope: Real third multi-file local web project, manual plan lifecycle, URL observation, cancellation, archive, restart. No live model or Bob.

checks.label: Reject remote/credential/privileged/Ming addresses
Register an independent multi-file local project
Custom target has no fabricated sample plan
Custom target cannot bypass confirmation through fixture API
Actual target probe returns page title and accessible control
Source observation excludes .env contents
Manual plan cannot save a criterion without an assertion
Manual plan rejects oversized work and path-like criterion identifiers
Manual draft links original requirement and claims no model generation
Real multi-file project passes manual acceptance and persistence
URL execution is explicitly observed, not frozen source
Revision creates a new immutable draft/version
Old confirmation cannot execute newly revised standards
Old confirmation and run remain unchanged for historical evidence
Workspace restores persisted requirements, latest drafts and inactive confirmation
Revised standards require and accept new explicit confirmation
Real URL assertion failure is recorded
Changed live project can pass rerun without falsely claiming frozen repair
Passed live URL acceptance enters review instead of failed
Same owner can retry once; all-pass second attempt stays review
Review status does not bypass the two-attempt limit
GET during a long run returns its persisted snapshot within one second
No overlapping run or archive while a target is active
Cancellation is persisted as error, never success
Page probe never follows a redirect to an unregistered origin
An explicit HTML outside the Ming repository can be registered
Imported HTML executes against the captured document snapshot
Global concurrency cap rejects a third browser run
In-flight run is persisted before browser completion
Restart converts unfinished run to explicit interrupted error
Restart recovers an actual in-flight repair task without fake completion
Custom target and project workspace survive restart
New requirement versions invalidate earlier confirmation for new runs
Archive retains target identity and original evidence
Archived target rejects fresh execution
Project list includes registered real projects
